{{short description|American professor}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=June 2025}}
'''Daniel S. Rokhsar''' is a professor in the departments of Physics and of Molecular and Cell Biology at [[University of California, Berkeley]]<ref>[http://mcb.berkeley.edu/index.php?option=com_mcbfaculty&name=rokhsard Faculty profile], UC Berkeley, Department of Molecular and Cell Biology, accessed 2011-06-23.</ref><ref>[http://physics.berkeley.edu/index.php?option=com_dept_management&act=people&Itemid=312&task=view&id=181 Faculty profile], UC Berkeley, Physics Department, accessed 2011-06-23.</ref> and Head of the Plant Genomics Program at the [[Joint Genome Institute]] of the [[United States Department of Energy]].<ref name="jgi">[http://www.jgi.doe.gov/research/rokhsar.html Daniel Rokhsar] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110430005557/http://www.jgi.doe.gov/research/rokhsar.html |date=2011-04-30 }}, JGI, accessed 2011-06-23.</ref> His research is focused on understanding the origin, evolution, and diversity of animals by combining [[computational genomics|computational genome analysis]] with comparative developmental biology.  Rokhsar received his Ph.D. in theoretical physics from [[Cornell University]] with doctoral advisors [[N. David Mermin]] and James Sethna,<ref>{{cite web|title=Daniel S. Rokhsar|website=Physics Tree|url=https://academictree.org/physics/peopleinfo.php?pid=448}}</ref> and joined the Berkeley faculty in 1989.<ref name="jgi"/>

==Awards==
As a teenager, Rokhsar was one of the winners in the [[Westinghouse Science Talent Search]].<ref>{{citation|title=New York Teen-Age Scientists Emerge on Top in Talent Search; Project Carried in Pocket|first=Ari L.|last=Goldman|journal=[[The New York Times]]|url=https://www.nytimes.com/1978/02/07/archives/new-york-teenage-scientists-emerge-on-top-in-talent-search-project.html|date=February 7, 1978}}.</ref>

Rokhsar was awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] in 2000.<ref>[http://www.gf.org/fellows/12435-daniel-s-rokhsar Daniel S. Rokhsar] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120921230112/http://www.gf.org/fellows/12435-daniel-s-rokhsar |date=2012-09-21 }}, Guggenheim Foundation, accessed 2011-06-23.</ref><ref>{{citation|title=Nine UC Researchers Win Guggenheim Fellowships|journal=Contra Costa Times|date=April 13, 2000}}.</ref>
